title: #079. e-Sports League Match & Venue Scheduling
subtitle: Assign league matches to compatible venues and timeslots maximizing viewership scores minus capped overtime penalties.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { assignedVenue, assignedSlot, overtime, netScore }.
judge.m2: Match {p0} assignment (venue={p1}, slot={p2}) must be (-1, -1) or valid indices.
judge.m3: Match {p0} cannot be assigned to incompatible venue {p1}.
judge.m4: Overtime in venue {p0}, slot {p1} ({p2}) exceeds allowed range [0, {p3}].
judge.m5: Venue {p0}, slot {p1} load ({p2}) exceeds regular length plus overtime ({p3}).
judge.m6: Reported netScore ({p0}) does not match computed viewership score minus overtime cost ({p1}).
judge.m7: Valid league schedule, but net score ({p0}) is below maximum ({p1}).
